verdict.rationale: Parsec's own docs show the host can scope guest access. A shared session can be observe-only or allow control, and the host can choose which apps guests may see and interact with. Nothing in the evidence covers per-guest clipboard or file-access permissions. missing for 10: clipboard permission scoping, file-transfer/file-access permission scoping, detailed docs on per-guest permission settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access

citations.quote: share a link, and a team member can observe or even take control of your computer.
The host can control exactly which apps connected guests are approved to see and interact with
